instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pull the comments on the posts of my Instagram professional account", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:pull-my-instagram-comments and its input (the worked example shows one).
